decisive_counterexample.native_dragonwrath_attempts: all original proc attempts accepted; rejected 0

first_broken_edge.evidence_limit: The current native callback cannot distinguish a Dragonwrath direct copy from the original spell when both use the original spell ID, and periodic copies use synthetic 101085 without a landed-copy marker. The bounded repair records only the copy cast scope; delayed or unmatched copies remain explicit and are not converted into a DPS claim.

hypothesis: The exact joined review admits gear, effective-stat, consumable, total-DPS, and tuning gates. The remaining Dragonwrath uncertainty is an observation contract defect: the aura handler submits the copy, but NotifyCombatDamage receives no copy scope. Starting a scoped, observation-only marker before the native copy cast and consuming it at landed damage will separate direct-copy damage from original spell totals and 101085 periodic-copy damage without changing combat, policy, or scoring.

smallest_lawful_repair_shape.production_contract: Expose the copy spell ID, landed damage, landed event count, and accepted-without-landed count in the existing per-bot Dragonwrath calibration row.
smallest_lawful_repair_shape.native_boundary: Set the marker immediately before CastSpell(triggerTarget, copySpellId, args), consume it only inside the existing scored NotifyCombatDamage callback for the same bot and copy spell ID, and clear it after the cast returns.
smallest_lawful_repair_shape.preserved_behavior: Do not change spell values, proc chance, target selection, cast flags, priorities, effective stats, reference inputs, scoring numerator, or encounter behavior.

net_gain_estimate.interpretation: 257.2744379 DPS is the apparent WoWSims Dragonwrath loss component, not an expected recoverable gain. The repair only improves attribution.

forbidden_changes: No gameplay, spell coefficient, stat, gear, consumable, proc-chance, target, priority, candidate-arbitration, encounter-script, route, WoWSims request/result, denominator, or scoring changes.
No live server launch, shard provisioning, raid validation, or new 300-second capture solely to redo the existing accounting.
Do not infer Dragonwrath damage from aggregate totals, assign delayed damage to a copy, or convert attribution resolution into actor or raid acceptance.
Do not touch other classes, specs, actors, healer/tank policy, or the open Magmaw 10N requirements.
acceptance_conditions: Focused tests prove the marker is registered before the copy cast, consumed only for the matching copy spell in the scored callback, and never participates in the damage accumulator or action selection.
The JSON row reports copy spell identity, landed damage/event counts, and accepted-without-landed counts while preserving per-bot binding and the explicit delayed/unmatched limitation.
Independent review approves the exact source and test delta and confirms the repair is observation-only with no native outcome or scoring mutation.
A clean gate-bearing native build is produced from the reviewed source before any matched verification is considered.
One matched exact-300 Balance calibration may verify the new observation surface only; it cannot accept actor performance or Magmaw raid performance.

jev.adjudication: Hosted Jev supports the corrected accounting scope and evidence direction; its insufficient-evidence acceptance disposition remains advisory and does not authorize native acceptance.

laya.adjudication: Local Laya supports the corrected scope, evidence, and plan claim at low confidence; advisory only.

interpretation: This plan addresses the first attributable evidence gap, not the aggregate DPS symptom. It preserves all actor and raid acceptance requirements and leaves the remaining native damage losses open until copied damage and original damage can be separated.
